isolation.restart: Original branch initial state only; no checkpoint
isolation.success_gate: Original quality and exact common accepted raw bytes; F10D float gates for derived morphology

diagnostics.selection: After isolation: earliest independent failed S/O case plus earliest archived preparation failure (1104); C uses the selected S/O case
diagnostics.stop: First physical step with original GPU error or original contact budget failure
diagnostics.candidate_end: Original failure interval end + 100 us, rounded upward to 50 us
diagnostics.observer: Read-only existing ContactTrace, original kernels; accepted-prefix regression

extension.selection: First passing short-window candidate in C1,C2,C3 order; projected compute cost <= 10 times original singleton, excluding observer overhead

morphology.gate: Report deltas over common accepted prefix; no preregistered physics-equivalence tolerance and therefore no promotion to default

yield_scope: Historical F10D production costs plus all F10E attempts; diagnostics separately itemized and also included in all-work rate; correlated variants remain one seed split group
